import unittest
from datetime import date
from bookings import Calendar

class BookingOverlapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_checkout_day_is_free_for_next_guest(self):
        calendar = Calendar()
        calendar.book(date(2024, 6, 1), date(2024, 6, 5))
        calendar.book(date(2024, 6, 5), date(2024, 6, 8))
        self.assertEqual(len(calendar.bookings), 2)

    def test_genuine_overlap_is_rejected(self):
        calendar = Calendar()
        calendar.book(date(2024, 6, 1), date(2024, 6, 5))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "overlapping booking"):
            calendar.book(date(2024, 6, 4), date(2024, 6, 6))

unittest.main()

import io
import tempfile
from wordcount import main

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("Don't stop, don't STOP! apple, apple; banana.")

import subprocess, sys, tempfile
text = "Apple apple, don't Don't! pear; pear pear.\n"
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', encoding='utf-8', delete=False) as f:
    f.write(text)
    path = f.name
checks = [
    ([path], 0, '7\n'),
    (['--top', '3', path], 0, "pear 3\napple 2\ndon't 2\n"),
    (['--top', '0', path], 2, ''),
    (['--top', 'nope', path], 2, ''),
]
for args, expected_code, expected_stdout in checks:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'wordcount.py', *args], text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode == expected_code, (args, result.returncode, result.stderr)
    assert result.stdout == expected_stdout, (args, result.stdout)
print('wordcount checks passed')
